qs.q: Where is your hometown, and what is it famous for?
qs.a: My hometown is Tissemsilt, a quiet city in the highlands of Algeria. It's known for its forests and cool winters.
qs.tip: اذكر المكان ثم معلومة مميزة واحدة، ولا تكتف بالاسم.

qs.q: Do you like living in your hometown?
qs.a: Yes, mostly. It's peaceful and everyone knows each other, although there are fewer job opportunities than in big cities.
qs.tip: أعطِ رأيًا ثم سببًا ثم تحفظًا صغيرًا ليبدو الجواب طبيعيًا.

qs.q: What changes have you seen in your hometown in recent years?
qs.a: A lot of new roads and shops have been built. The centre is busier now, and young people use the internet much more.
qs.tip: استعمل المضارع التام أو الماضي للحديث عن التغيّر.

qs.q: Would you recommend your hometown to visitors?
qs.a: Definitely. They could walk in the nearby woods and try the local food, and the people are very welcoming.
qs.tip: يمكنك استعمال could وwould لتقديم اقتراح مهذب.

qs.q: What are you studying at the moment?
qs.a: I'm doing a master's degree in transparency and anti-corruption. It's quite demanding, but I find it very interesting.
qs.tip: لا تذكر اسم التخصص فقط، أضف شعورك تجاهه.

qs.q: Why did you choose this subject?
qs.a: I wanted to understand how public institutions can be fairer. I also think it will give me useful skills for research.
qs.tip: أجب بـ because أو I wanted to لتعطي سببًا واضحًا.

qs.q: What is the most difficult part of your studies?
qs.a: Reading long academic articles in English is the hardest part. I often need to read them twice to understand the main idea.
qs.tip: تحدث عن صعوبة حقيقية ثم اذكر كيف تتعامل معها.

qs.q: How do you usually study for exams?
qs.a: I make short summaries and test myself with questions. I study in the library because it's quiet and I can concentrate there.
qs.tip: اذكر عادتين محددتين لتبدو إجابتك غنية.

qs.q: What kind of work do you do?
qs.a: I work with technical documents for construction projects. I write and organise reports, so accuracy is very important.
qs.tip: صف عملك بجملة بسيطة ثم اذكر ما يهم فيه.

qs.q: What do you enjoy most about your job?
qs.a: I enjoy solving problems and seeing a project move forward. It's also satisfying when a long document is finally finished.
qs.tip: استخدم enjoy مع اسم أو -ing.

qs.q: Is there anything you dislike about your work?
qs.a: Sometimes the deadlines are very tight, which can be stressful. However, it teaches me to plan my time carefully.
qs.tip: بعد ذكر السلبية أضف However لتنهي بنبرة إيجابية.

qs.q: What job would you like to do in the future?
qs.a: I'd like to become a researcher in the field of law and technology. I hope to work at a university abroad one day.
qs.tip: استعمل I'd like to وI hope to للحديث عن المستقبل.

qs.q: Tell me about your family.
qs.a: There are six of us in my family: my parents, two brothers and a sister. We're very close and we have dinner together every Friday.
qs.tip: اذكر العدد ثم تفصيلًا شخصيًا صغيرًا.

qs.q: Who are you closest to in your family?
qs.a: I'm closest to my mother. She always listens to me and gives me good advice when I'm worried.
qs.tip: الجملة الثانية تشرح السبب، وهذا ما يريده الممتحن.

qs.q: Do you spend much time with your family?
qs.a: Yes, whenever I can. Because of my studies I'm often busy, but we talk on the phone almost every day.
qs.tip: whenever I can عبارة مفيدة وطبيعية.

qs.q: Do you think family is important?
qs.a: Of course. Family gives you support when things are difficult, and it teaches you values that stay with you for life.
qs.tip: اربط الرأي بسبب ومثال عام.

qs.q: What is your daily routine like?
qs.a: I get up at about six, have breakfast and go to the university. In the evening I study for a few hours and then go to bed.
qs.tip: استخدم كلمات الترتيب مثل then وafter that.

qs.q: Which part of the day do you like best?
qs.a: I like the evening best because it's calm. I can read or study without being interrupted.
qs.tip: اذكر وقتًا محددًا وسببه.

qs.q: Do you have the same routine at the weekend?
qs.a: Not really. At the weekend I sleep later and meet friends, so my days are much more relaxed.
qs.tip: Not really طريقة طبيعية للنفي الخفيف.

qs.q: Would you like to change anything in your routine?
qs.a: Yes, I'd like to do some exercise every morning. At the moment I don't have enough time, but I'm trying to plan better.
qs.tip: استخدم الشرط أو I'd like to للحديث عن تغيير.

qs.q: What kinds of food do you like?
qs.a: I love traditional Algerian dishes like couscous, but I also enjoy fresh salads and grilled fish.
qs.tip: أعط مثالين محددين بدل قول I like everything.

qs.q: Do you prefer eating at home or in restaurants?
qs.a: I prefer eating at home because the food is healthier and cheaper. Still, I sometimes go out with friends for a change.
qs.tip: prefer مع because ثم Still للتوازن.

qs.q: Can you cook?
qs.a: I can cook a few simple dishes, such as rice with vegetables. I'd like to learn more because cooking is a useful skill.
qs.tip: اذكر ما تستطيع فعله بدقة بدل نعم أو لا.

qs.q: Has your diet changed in recent years?
qs.a: Yes, I eat less sugar than before. I try to have more fruit and drink more water, because I care about my health.
qs.tip: استخدم المضارع التام أو المقارنة مثل less than.

qs.q: What is the weather like in your region?
qs.a: Winters are cold and sometimes snowy, while summers are hot and dry. Spring is the nicest season, in my opinion.
qs.tip: while مفيدة للمقارنة بين فصلين.

qs.q: What kind of weather do you like?
qs.a: I like mild, sunny weather because I can go out and walk. I don't enjoy very hot days, as they make me tired.
qs.tip: اذكر سببًا لما تحبه ولما لا تحبه.

qs.q: Does the weather affect your mood?
qs.a: Yes, definitely. When it's grey and rainy, I feel lazy, but sunshine gives me more energy.
qs.tip: استعمل when لتصف علاقة السبب بالنتيجة.

qs.q: Has the weather changed where you live?
qs.a: I think summers are hotter than they used to be. People also say that there is less rain, which worries farmers.
qs.tip: used to تناسب الحديث عن الماضي مقابل الحاضر.

qs.q: What do you like doing in your free time?
qs.a: I like reading and walking in the open air. Recently I've also started learning how to edit videos.
qs.tip: اذكر هوايتين، وواحدة منهما حديثة تعطي حيوية.

qs.q: How did you become interested in that hobby?
qs.a: A friend showed me some videos, and I wanted to try it myself. After a few weeks, I was hooked.
qs.tip: be hooked تعبير عامي مقبول يعني أُغرمت به.

qs.q: Do you prefer hobbies you do alone or with others?
qs.a: It depends. Reading is better alone, but I enjoy football much more with friends because it's more fun.
qs.tip: It depends تمنحك وقتًا للتفكير وتفتح جوابًا متوازنًا.

qs.q: Is there a hobby you would like to try?
qs.a: I'd love to try photography. I think it would help me see ordinary places in a new way.
qs.tip: استعمل would للتعبير عن أمنية.

qs.q: Do you play any sports?
qs.a: I play football once a week with my friends. I'm not very skilled, but it's great exercise and a lot of fun.
qs.tip: اعترف بمستواك بصدق، فهذا طبيعي ومقبول.

qs.q: What sports are popular in your country?
qs.a: Football is by far the most popular. People of all ages watch matches, and kids play in the streets after school.
qs.tip: by far للتأكيد على الأكثر شعبية.

qs.q: Do you think sport is important for young people?
qs.a: Yes, because it keeps them healthy and teaches teamwork. It also gives them something positive to do instead of staying on their phones.
qs.tip: سببان للإجابة أفضل من سبب واحد.

qs.q: Would you like to try a new sport?
qs.a: I'd like to try swimming. It's good for the whole body, and I've never had proper lessons.
qs.tip: اذكر سببًا وحقيقة شخصية عن تجربتك السابقة.

qs.q: Do you enjoy reading?
qs.a: Yes, I read almost every day, mostly articles and non-fiction books. I find it relaxing and it improves my vocabulary.
qs.tip: اذكر ما تقرأ ولماذا تقرأ.

qs.q: What kind of books do you like?
qs.a: I prefer books about history and science because they explain how the world works. Now and then I read a good novel, too.
qs.tip: Now and then تعبير طبيعي بمعنى أحيانًا.

qs.q: Do you prefer paper books or e-books?
qs.a: I prefer e-books because I can carry hundreds of them on my phone. However, paper books are better for long, quiet reading.
qs.tip: قارن بين الخيارين بوضوح باستعمال However.

qs.q: Did you read a lot when you were a child?
qs.a: Not much, to be honest. We didn't have many books at home, but I started reading more when I went to university.
qs.tip: to be honest عبارة مفيدة وتجعل الجواب صادقًا.

qs.q: Do you like travelling?
qs.a: Yes, very much. I enjoy discovering new places and trying different food, but I don't travel as often as I'd like.
qs.tip: as often as I'd like مقارنة طبيعية جدًا.

qs.q: What was the best trip you have ever taken?
qs.a: I once visited the north coast with my family. The sea was beautiful, and we stayed in a small village for a week.
qs.tip: استعمل الماضي البسيط لتروي رحلة محددة.

qs.q: Do you prefer travelling alone or with other people?
qs.a: I prefer travelling with friends because it's safer and more fun. On the other hand, travelling alone lets you decide everything yourself.
qs.tip: On the other hand لإظهار الوجه الآخر.

qs.q: Which country would you like to visit in the future?
qs.a: I'd love to visit Japan. I'm interested in its technology and its culture, and I hear that the cities are very clean.
qs.tip: I hear that طريقة لطيفة لنقل معلومة سمعتها.

qs.q: What technology do you use every day?
qs.a: I use my phone and laptop all day long. I use them for studying, communicating and finding information.
qs.tip: اذكر شيئين ثم الغرض من استعمالهما.

qs.q: Has technology made your life easier?
qs.a: Yes, in many ways. I can access books and lessons online, so I don't always need to go to the library.
qs.tip: in many ways تسمح بذكر مثال بعدها.

qs.q: Is there any technology you find annoying?
qs.a: Notifications annoy me a lot. They interrupt my work, so I often turn my phone off when I study.
qs.tip: annoy فعل جيد، واذكر الحل الذي تتبعه.

qs.q: How do you think technology will change education?
qs.a: I think students will use more artificial intelligence to practise and get feedback. Still, teachers will remain important to guide them.
qs.tip: لا بأس بالتوقع باستعمال will مع I think.
